title: JNU students hold indefinite hunger strike over disciplinary action and campus issues

tea.why: Students are protesting against disciplinary actions, restrictions on protests, and deteriorating infrastructure at the campus.
tea.want: They demand the revocation of rustication notices and the Chief Proctor Manual, alongside infrastructure and academic reforms.
tea.changed: Oct 8: The indefinite hunger strike by students and union office-bearers entered its fifth day.

summary: Students and office-bearers of the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students Union (JNUSU) launched an indefinite hunger strike on the Delhi campus to protest disciplinary actions and various campus-related issues. The participants, including rusticated union office-bearers, raised concerns regarding restrictions on student demonstrations, crumbling hostel infrastructure, and academic procedures. During the agitation, the union screened a film at the strike site. Organisers alleged that the university administration threatened further disciplinary extensions and denied medical check-ups to rusticated participants. The university administration stated that no permission had been granted for the film screening and did not respond to the protesters' core demands.
demands: Revocation of the Chief Proctor Office Manual and rustication notices
Reinstatement of the Gender Sensitisation Committee Against Sexual Harassment
Restoration of the JNU Entrance Examination
Renovation of campus infrastructure and hostels
Reforms in the Equal Opportunity Cell in line with the Rohith Act
response: A JNU official stated that no permission had been given for the film screening. According to the student union, the Chief Security Officer warned office-bearers of extended rustication and alleged violation of bail conditions over the hunger strike. University officials have not responded to the protesters' demands.

crowd.text: 17 students, including JNUSU office-bearers, have been on an indefinite hunger strike

updates.text: The JNUSU screened 'Palestine 36' at the hunger strike site as the agitation entered its fourth day.
The indefinite hunger strike by three union office-bearers and 14 students entered its fifth day.
